title: Touring the South
summary: He played schools, dances and theaters in the South, with tours of 61 one-nighters.

story.theme_name: Life on the road: touring bands, buses and one-nighters
story.community_name: Life on the road: buses, trains and one-nighters

blocks.x: Did you tour much in the South?
Oh yeah. I did a lot of touring in the South. And during, I played a

lot of schools and all that. Besides dances and theaters, the ones that had theaters, I did quite a bit of touring. I remember touring there with Roy Hamilton 61 one-nighters after playing 18 one-nighters straight with Nat Cole. I jumped from one to the other. That's a lot of one nighters.
At one time, without a break. You know, one to the other.
